title: API plans and access
snippet:
Get a key
1
Open the dashboard
Sign in to Consensus and go to [consensus.app/api-mcp](https://consensus.app/api-mcp/), or click your profile icon and choose **API & MCP Dashboard**.
2
Create a key
Click **Create API key**, name it, and copy it. If you already have a key, open **Keys and clients** and click **New key**. The full key is shown once.
3
Send it on every request
Pass the key in the `x-api-key` header. Requests without a valid key return `401`.
##
​
What each plan includes
| | Free | Pro | Teams | Deep | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Included calls per month | 30 | 500 | 500 | 2,000 | Custom |
| Max calls with additional usage | 30 | 1,000 | 1,000 | 10,000 | Custom |
| Max papers per request (`page_size`) | 20 | 300 | 300 | 750 | 1,000 |
| Pagination past the first page | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| [Full-text excerpts](/api-full-text) | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| [Complete text](/api-full-text#complete-text) of open-access papers** | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Institutional full-text links (`institutional_access_url`)* | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Citations and references (beta)*** | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Rate limit | 1 request/second | 1 request/second | 1 request/second | 1 request/second | Custom |

*** `GET /v1beta/papers/citations` and `GET /v1beta/papers/references`, at 1 credit per 100 papers returned. Both are in beta, so their request and response schemas may change in the coming days. Every plan can use every search filter. Compare plans at [consensus.app/pricing](https://consensus.app/pricing).

title: Get started with Consensus API
snippet:
Make your first API call in a few minutes. Every plan includes API access, and the Free plan includes 30 calls a month.
1
Sign in to Consensus
Create a free account or sign in at [consensus.app](https://consensus.app). The dashboard in the next step only opens when you’re signed in.
2
Open the API & MCP Dashboard
Go to [consensus.app/api-mcp](https://consensus.app/api-mcp/). You can also get there from your profile icon: choose **API & MCP Dashboard**.

## Base URL and authentication
All requests go to:
```
https://api.consensus.app
```
Every request must include your API key in the `x-api-key` header:
```
x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY
```
See [plans and access](/api-plans-and-access) for each plan’s monthly calls, page sizes, features, and rate limits.

title: docs.consensus.app/api-reference/search.md
snippet:
title: Consensus API
description: >-
Search usage is billed in calls: one call per 100 papers returned, rounded
up, with a minimum of 1 call per request. Usage counts against your plan's
included monthly calls. Free plans include 30 calls per month, Pro and Teams
plans include 500, and Deep plans include 2,000. Paid plans with an active
metered API subscription may continue past the included limit; additional
calls are billed at $0.05 per call. Enterprise API keys have unlimited
access.

title: Subscription Plans
snippet:
# **Free Tier**
- **Cost:** $0
- **Description:** Ideal for users just getting started with Consensus. The Free tier gives you access to essential search functionalities, allowing you to explore and familiarize yourself with the platform.
- **Features:**
- Unlimited Papers searches per month
- 10 Pro messages per month
- 3 Deep reviews per month
- 10 Study Snapshots per month
- 30 included [API & MCP](https://consensus.app/api-mcp/) calls per month
---
# **Pro Subscription**
- **Cost:** $20/month or $144/year (billed annually, equivalent to $12/month)
- **Description:** Our most popular plan! Pro unlocks unlimited Pro Searches plus 15 Deep Searches per month. It’s ideal for users who want full access to advanced AI features for deeper, evidence-based insights.
- **Features:**
- Unlimited Papers searches per month
- Unlimited Pro messages per month
- 15 Deep reviews per month
- Unlimited Study Snapshots
- 500 included [API & MCP](https://consensus.app/api-mcp/) calls per month

# **Enterprise Plan**
- **Cost:** Email [[email protected]](https://help.consensus.app/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#4d3e2c21283e0d2e22233e28233e383e632c3d3d) for a custom quote.
- **Description:** Tailored for large organizations, universities, and institutes with over 200 users. The Enterprise plan provides services for large-scale research needs.
- **Features:**
- All Team features
- Greater volume discounts
- Manage thousands of users
- Early access to features in development
- All user data is secure and private
- Centralized billing & account management
- Development partner program (for organizations with 500+ users)
- Library integrations
- Product training and search optimization sessions for users
- 500 included [API & MCP](https://consensus.app/api-mcp/) calls per user, per month

title: GitHub - Consensus-NLP/consensus-api: Consensus REST API. Semantic search over 400M+ peer-reviewed research papers, including all of PubMed, for RAG, AI agents and research tools.
snippet:
Every plan includes API access. The Free plan includes 30 calls a month, so you can make a request in a couple of minutes.

## Plans, pricing and rate limits
| | Free | Pro / Teams | Deep | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Included calls per month | 30 | 500 | 2,000 | Custom |
| Max papers per request | 20 | 300 | 750 | 1,000 |
| Pagination | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Full-text excerpts | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Rate limit | 1 req/s | 1 req/s | 1 req/s | Custom |
A call is one request per 100 papers returned (20 papers = 1 call, 150 papers = 2 calls). Paid plans can turn on additional usage at $0.05 per call. The API and the [Consensus MCP server](https://github.com/Consensus-NLP/consensus-mcp) share one monthly pool. Details: [API plans and access](https://docs.consensus.app/api-plans-and-access). Plan prices: [consensus.app/pricing](https://consensus.app/pricing/).

| | Consensus API | Free scholarly metadata APIs |
|---|---|---|
| Coverage | 400M+ articles across all fields, including all of PubMed | Varies: biomedical only (PubMed, Europe PMC) or all fields (OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, Crossref) |
| Search | Semantic ranking tuned for research questions | Mostly keyword, Boolean or field queries |
| Evidence signals per paper | Study type, sample size, journal quartile, takeaway | Usually publication type and citation counts |
| Full text | Licensed and open-access full-text passages | Abstracts and metadata; open-access full text in some |
| Research agent | Threads API returns cited, written answers | No |
| Cost | Free tier, then plan-based | Free |
